name: Legrand SA

profile.end_markets: Datacenters (26% of 2025 sales), non-residential & residential buildings, infrastructure. North & Central America 42.2% of 2025 revenue (US 39.2%); Europe 38.0% (FY2025 release).
profile.products: LV electrical & digital building infrastructure: wiring devices, LV circuit breakers/distribution (DX3), cable management, UPS, datacenter white-space (Starline Track busway, PDUs, cabinets/containment, liquid cooling, Avtron load banks), building systems/AV. No MV/HV transformers — exposure to Sanil is only via US datacenter/non-residential construction power-distribution demand.

proxy_routes.why: US electrical equipment & component shipments — US ≈39% of Legrand sales
US electrical equipment new orders — short-cycle LV demand
US imports of ≤1 kV boards/panels — LV distribution demand incl. datacenters
French C27.1 production — Legrand French LV plants (Limoges)
US total non-residential construction spending (FRED TLNRESCONS) — buildings end-market; not in pre-built proxy list
US private data-center construction put-in-place (Census) — datacenters 26% of sales
EU building construction production index — Europe 38% of sales

structural_breaks.affects_target_note: builder annotation 2026-09-25 from the break note: consolidated net sales unaffected (geographic redefinition)
structural_breaks.note: Geographic segment redefinition (Europe region from 2019); consolidated net sales unaffected.
Universal Electric Corporation (Starline busway, US datacenter power distribution) acquired in 2019 (main 9M 2019 acquisition).
Sale of Russian activities announced (exit from Russia; sales not restated).
Avtron Power Solutions (US load banks) acquisition announced; 2025 datacenter acquisitions (Linkk Busway, Amperio, etc.) — datacenters 26% of 2025 sales.
